message: This has been a great thread--thanks, Mike, Bill, Collin. I've been out of town and off-blogging for several days and need to catch up. I'd like to say more, but am not sufficiently focused at the moment. So I'll just ask a question: are you using Bourdieu at all, Mike? The argument about how we see as extra-economic all these transactions that are very much economic reminds me of arguments he makes in *Practical Reason* and elsewhere.
